scope: Visual only; original Vue controls and gameplay preserved.

assets.role: UI impression concept; not a runtime background
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / art-directed game interface impression.
Create a genuinely beautiful production-quality visual concept for the Chinese Touhou fan text-adventure game "东方异变录". EDIT the supplied screenshot as an information architecture reference only. Recompose and repaint the visual design, rather than doing a recolor. Keep its functional regions and existing small NPC portraits; do not invent new functions or redesign the characters.
Direction requested by the player: 红白神社、清透雅致 (vermilion-and-white Shinto shrine, luminous, airy, elegant). It must feel like a carefully illustrated doujin visual-novel game, not a SaaS dashboard.
Output: one flat straight-on complete desktop game UI image, landscape 16:10, no device, browser chrome, desk, mockup framing or explanatory labels. Finished UI art, not a wireframe.
Palette: clean pearl white, deep shrine vermilion, soft rose, smoky charcoal ink, small restrained gold and blue-green foliage accents. No dominant beige, dark gray panels, purple washes, neon, bokeh, floating orbs.
Composition:
1. One slim integrated top strip: a refined yin-yang crest, title "东方异变录", player "白羽", location, day/time, small utility symbols. No second toolbar.
2. Story region takes left 73%, right journal rail 27%. The upper part of the story has a wide, airy hand-painted panorama of a red torii and Hakurei-style shrine, white shide paper streamers, spring foliage, pale sky. Shrine architecture on the RIGHT of that panorama, clean negative space on the LEFT for "博丽神社" in elegant dark-red Chinese serif lettering. Scene panorama occupies about 23% of the viewport, not the whole interface. Do not drown the entire page in a background image.
3. Below panorama, story reads like a beautiful open Japanese letter on a luminous paper-white surface, unframed rather than a giant floating rounded card. A narrow red bookmark/ofuda marker anchors the narrator line "旁白", delicate corner rules and a tiny knot detail at most. Real readable Chinese story text, regular dark ink, generous line height. Use 3 short paragraphs: "清晨的风掠过鸟居，纸垂在檐下轻轻摇晃。" "灵梦放下茶盏，朝参道的方向望了一眼。" "大结界的微光仍在远处闪动。你打算先向谁问问？" A separate small soft-red player response row may say "先向灵梦问好。". Keep compact copy/rating/retry actions below the message.
4. Right side is a finely composed white '人物' journal, not nested cards. Five tabs "人物 地图 线索 日常 状态". Small heading "此间相逢", three existing circular portrait medallions from reference with names "博丽灵梦", "八云紫", "八云蓝", quiet identity lines, compact details and talk actions. Elegant spacing, subtle hairlines; preserve the supplied miniature portraits rather than inventing new character designs.
5. Bottom of story region contains a slim suggestions row and two actual text entry areas labeled "行动" and "台词", plus a compact vermilion "宣言行动" button styled as a carefully edged charm. Preserve these as real-looking interactive controls with enough space for typed text.
Signature: a restrained shrine paper-ribbon / folded white shide motif at the story-to-panorama boundary and tiny red ties in structural corners, complemented by fine calligraphic chapter typography. These details should feel authored, not stock rounded boxes with kanji stickers.
No long instructional paragraphs, no advertising copy, no UI explanation, no giant empty card. Keep hierarchy, balanced whitespace and legibility. Showcase a new art direction that could faithfully be rebuilt as responsive Vue components and CSS.

assets.role: Shrine scene illustration behind live title
assets.prompt: Edit the supplied game UI concept into ONE reusable background illustration asset. Extract and redraw ONLY the shrine panorama visible across the upper left part, keeping exactly its exquisite hand-painted Japanese doujin watercolor / anime environment style and bright pearl-white and vermilion mood. A wide red-and-white shrine to the RIGHT, a red torii near the center, white shide streamers, pale blue spring sky, green trees, a light flowering cherry branch framing the upper LEFT. Preserve LEFT 40% as soft pale open sky and distant foliage with no foreground objects, for live game title text. Landscape panoramic image about 4:1, full-bleed, no frame. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, buttons, UI panels, character portraits, paper page, bottom rope, logos or watermark. This is the scene artwork only, to be placed behind HTML title text. Bright, clear, delicate, refined, not beige, no star circles or magical bokeh. Do not render any characters.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent UI decoration for this shrine game. Reference image is the approved UI concept. Extract and beautifully redraw ONLY the thin rope decoration dividing the shrine panorama from the white story page. Extremely wide horizontal red and pale-gold twisted cord, gentle shallow curve, a SMALL centered vermilion mizuhiki ribbon knot and two short tassels, two white folded shide streamers near the far left and far right. Keep all elements in a shallow horizontal strip through the CENTER of a panoramic canvas, no cropping at edges. Fine hand-painted watercolor anime detail, restrained scale. Genuine transparent background (alpha), NO paper, white rectangle, shrine, flowers, letters, words, panels, interface, watermark, characters, opaque backdrop. Only the cord, central ribbon and paper shide, clean isolated cutout. Wide aspect ratio 3:1.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent lower-right corner ornament for a red-and-white shrine game journal UI. Reference is the approved interface concept; extract and redraw ONLY its lovely BOTTOM RIGHT flowering branch, in the same fine hand-painted watercolor anime style. One elegant diagonal branch entering from the lower-right, one large vermilion camellia blossom, two small red blossoms, a few delicate white-pink blossoms and muted jade green leaves. Light, refined, airy. Most of the UPPER LEFT of the square canvas empty and transparent; the modest branch occupies lower-right half only. Genuine transparent alpha background. No paper, shrine, characters, portraits, interface, letters, words, frame, watermark, rope, abstract circles or bokeh. Keep branch stems anatomically connected, no scattered floating decorations.
